text.reference: ワレハ{race}{demon_name}{n}コンゴトモヨロシク
text.translation: I AM {race} {demon_name}.{n}I LOOK FORWARD TO WORKING WITH YOU.

text.reference: オレサマハ{race}{demon_name}{n}コノオレノチカラミセテヤロウ
text.translation: I AM {race} {demon_name}!{n}BEHOLD MY POWER!

text.reference: 我は{demon_name}{race}なり{n}そなたに加勢して進ぜよう
text.translation: I am {demon_name} of the {race}.{n}I shall lend thee my aid.

text.reference: 私は{race}{demon_name}{n}貴方を主とし力戦すること{n}この名に掛けて誓いましょう
text.translation: I am {race} {demon_name}.{n}I swear upon my name to take you as my master{n}and fight with all my strength.

text.reference: わたくしは{race}{demon_name}{n}貴方の命運のため御助力いたしましょう
text.translation: I am {race} {demon_name}.{n}I shall aid you in shaping your destiny.

text.reference: 俺は{race}{demon_name}だ{n}ま今後ともよろしく頼むぜ
text.translation: I'm {race} {demon_name}.{n}Good to be working with you.

text.reference: {demon_name}は{race}なの{n}{first_name}さんよろしくネ
text.translation: I'm {demon_name}, a {race}.{n}Nice to meet you, {first_name}!

text.reference: ボク{race}{demon_name}！{n}今後ともよろしくー！
text.translation: I'm {race} {demon_name}!{n}Let's be friends!

text.reference: あたし{race}{demon_name}！{n}女の子なんだからやさしくしてね
text.translation: I'm {race} {demon_name}!{n}I'm a girl, so be nice to me, okay?

text.reference: アタシは{race}{demon_name}{n}どーぞ今後ともよろしく
text.translation: I'm {race} {demon_name}.{n}Do take good care of me.

text.reference: オレは{race}{demon_name}だ！{n}オレは{race}{demon_name}だ！{n}オレが{race}{demon_name}だ！！
text.translation: I'm {race} {demon_name}!{n}I'm {race} {demon_name}!{n}I'M {race} {demon_name}!!

text.reference: わしは{race}{demon_name}{n}お若いのよろしくな
text.translation: I am {race} {demon_name}.{n}I'm counting on you, youngster.

text.reference: 俺は{race}{demon_name}{n}あんまりムチャさせんなよ
text.translation: I'm {race} {demon_name}.{n}Don't push me too hard.

text.reference: わいが{race}{demon_name}や！{n}文句あんのかおんどれ！！
text.translation: I'm {race} {demon_name}!{n}You got a problem with that, punk?!
Slrrp...... Slrrp........{n}Sluurp... Sluuurp.....

text.reference: ワタシハ{race}{demon_name}{n}アナタノ命令ニシタガイマス
text.translation: I AM {race} {demon_name}.{n}I WILL OBEY YOUR ORDERS.

text.reference: われは{demon_name}{n}幸なる力にてそなたを助けん
text.translation: I am {demon_name}.{n}My blessed power shall aid thee.

text.reference: われは{demon_name}{n}奇なる力にてそなたを助けん
text.translation: I am {demon_name}.{n}My wondrous power shall aid thee.

text.reference: われは{demon_name}{n}荒ぶる力にてそなたを助けん
text.translation: I am {demon_name}.{n}My raging power shall aid thee.

text.reference: われは{demon_name}{n}和なる力にてそなたを助けん
text.translation: I am {demon_name}.{n}My harmonious power shall aid thee.

text.reference: 私は{race}{demon_name}{n}いつでもあなたと共にあり{n}全ての邪悪を滅しましょう
text.translation: I am {race} {demon_name}.{n}I shall stand beside you always{n}and destroy all evil.

text.reference: 我は{race}{demon_name}{n}ここに誓いを立て貴殿を我が主君とし{n}身命掛けて御守り致しましょう
text.translation: I am {race} {demon_name}.{n}I swear to take you as my liege{n}and guard you with my life.

text.reference: 我は{race}{demon_name}{n}我が降魔の力そなたに御貸しいたそう
text.translation: I am {race} {demon_name}.{n}I shall lend you my demon-quelling power.

text.reference: {demon_name}見参！！
text.translation: {demon_name} has arrived!!

text.reference: わたしは{race}{demon_name}{n}わが自由もわが平等もわが博愛も{n}あなたのお手に預けましょう
text.translation: I am {race} {demon_name}.{n}My liberty, equality, and fraternity{n}are now entrusted to you.

text.reference: 我は{race}{demon_name}{n}黄泉に生きる者の力お目にかけよう
text.translation: I am {race} {demon_name}.{n}Behold the power of one who dwells in Yomi.

text.reference: わしは{race}{demon_name}じゃ{n}地獄の案内ならおまかせくだされ
text.translation: I am {race} {demon_name}.{n}Leave it to me if you need a guide through Hell.

text.reference: オレは{race}{demon_name}{n}冥府の淵よりここに参上
text.translation: I am {race} {demon_name}.{n}I have come from the depths of the underworld.

text.reference: 私は{race}{demon_name}{n}奈落の声を聞くがよい・・・
text.translation: I am {race} {demon_name}.{n}Hear the voice of the abyss...

text.reference: わたしは{race}{demon_name}・・・{n}死の安らぎを全てのものに・・・・・・
text.translation: I am {race} {demon_name}...{n}May death's peace come to all...

text.reference: 本官は屍鬼ゾンビコップであります！{n}今後ともよろしくお願いするであります！
text.translation: I am Haunt Zombie Cop, reporting for duty!{n}I look forward to serving with you!
